notes: Sides (README rule 1): the innermost rule is the thin rule beside the thick bar (inner on every side). Its inner edge was measured column by column wherever paper (a street) lies beside it, smoothed along each side with a robust local-linear fit (the page is turned ~0.5 degree and the rules bow: left ~20 px, right ~33, top ~23, bottom ~45 end to end), and the outline set ~1.5 px inside that edge (the first clean paper row), points every ~80-250 px; the bars are speckled, so a few single columns still touch a speck of the rule's edge. Along the top the solid Market St blocks and the hatched blocks run into the thin rule for nearly its whole length, and along the left the hatched blocks do the same: there the outline follows the rule's inner edge through the block ink (kind b: almost all the ink left under the outline; the rule's edge there is taken from the streets either side). Bottom: hatched blocks reach the thin rule at x ~2300-2570 (kind b). Corners (rule 2): top-left, the outline runs ~1 px inside the inner edge of the thin (innermost) arc; the Market St blocks run across the arcs (the thin arc is fused with block ink for most of its length), so the thin arc's inner edge there is its outer edge (the white line between the thick and thin arcs) plus the arc's thickness measured where it is clean, and the blocks beyond it are outside (kind b); block outlines touch the arc at x 340-480 (kind b). The other three corners are unchanged (on paper ~4-5 px inside the thin arc). Remove polygons (README rule 4, owner 2026-11-20): (1) the rotated CITY & COUNTY ... ZONE MAP title, legend and scale block (lower right; no ruled box; on open bay paper; rectangle ~4 px outside its ink), (2) the compass rose with its three long arrows (12-point outline on paper; it runs between the arrows and the PIER HEAD LINE dash-dot line and its HEAD lettering, ~6-15 px from each, so that map line stays map; no map ink inside), (3) the SECTION 8 badge (octagon ~4 px outside the ring, clear of the bottom-right arc). The title block, compass and badge were holes (the badge briefly a notch). No holes: 'Join Sec. 9' (inside the frame at lower left) is a floating cross-reference and is inside now. 'Join Sec. 1' prints above the top bar and 'Join Sec. 7' left of the left bar, so both are outside. BAY OF SAN FRANCISCO, PIER HEAD LINE, FERRY BUILDING, street lettering and the dotted box round Mission Rock (a real island) are map.
